dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Steady, linear convergence of the lateral margins from the cranial-most visible section toward the posterior peduncle region.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Visible margins appear smooth and symmetrical with no distinct lateral bulges or indentations.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Uniform light slate-grey median pixel intensity across the visible dorsal plane.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Faint, low-contrast longitudinal linear markings on the right-lateral side of the dorsal surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Faint linear scratches or rake marks visible on the posterior right dorsal quadrant.
